Product Description               The Melissa & Doug Burrow Bunny Stuffed Animal Plushie is a velvety-soft, floppy-eared friend that invites hugs and sparks smiles. Its gentle gray coat and brilliant white tail blends beautifully into nurseries and playrooms as charming baby room decor, offering both comfort and charm. With big, floppy feet and a fuzzy finish, Burrow delivers a delightfully cuddly feel that kids (and parents) love to touch and snuggle. Whether for play, rest, or travel, this 9-inch cute stuffed animal is loved as both boy and girl toys, bringing joy and laughter to everyday routines. Built with reinforced stitching and neatly finished seams, it's made to withstand years of hugs and adventures and then passed on for years to come. A heartfelt gift for any age or occasion: Whether it's a baby shower gift, a thoughtful 2 year old birthday gift, Easter basket surprise, or toddler toy for any occasion. For over 30 years, Melissa and Doug have crafted durable, imaginative preschool toys—built to nurture childhood wonder, with everything from life-sized grocery or play kitchen playsets, play food to serve to stuffed animals & puppets, or costumes, arts & crafts & road trip activities for kids, that support open-ended play, screen free learning and fun.                  Brand Story               By Melissa & Doug
                    From the Manufacturer               From classic wooden toys to crafts, pretend play, and games, Melissa & Doug products provide a launch pad to ignite imagination and a sense of wonder in all children so they can discover themselves, their passions, and their purpose.

Since the company’s founding more than 25 years ago, Melissa & Doug has consistently delivered innovative products that inspire open-ended thinking, encourage kids to see new possibilities, and offer Countless Ways to Play. It’s part of a bigger vision to Take Back Childhood. Because by giving children a true childhood with the space and freedom to explore their world, we give them a path to realizing their full potential!             See more

items: Premium Plush Toy for Comfort & Snuggles – This extra-soft bunny features floppy ears, expressive eyes, & huge feet, in a gentle sitting pose; an ideal stuffed animal to appeal to kids and collectors
Emotional Support & Sensory Toy – Burrow is 9-inch bunny plush that promotes bonding, on-the-go comfort, bedtime cuddles and imaginative play—ideal toddler toy for screen-free play with plushies
Snuggly & Built to Last – With surface-washable materials that stand up to repeated hugs and imaginary pretend play; this teddy bear-style bunny makes cute room decor or nursery bedroom décor
